_comment: DOUBLER COMBAT PAY -- a creature the plan casts BEFORE the deferred doubler can be its attacker (Morph INT-16 A/B
finding, seed 97000 gi 69 turn 3). Two Ignoble Hierarchs, Gruul Turf; Stomping Ground, Blistering Firecat, Berserk in
hand; opponent at 18. The kill: hard-cast Firecat ({1}{R}{R}{R}: Turf R+G, Stomping R, one Hierarch R; haste 7/1)
attacks alone (exalted x2 = 9), Berserk in the declare-attackers step off the OTHER Hierarch's {G}: 18. The exact
probe paid the plan on a copy without resolving it, so the combat payment held the pre-plan best attacker (a
Hierarch) and Berserk's {G} looked unpayable; Berserk went in main (7 x 2 + 2 = 16, opponent at 2). Fixed: the copy
puts each creature the plan casts before the deferred doublers onto its battlefield (sick unless haste).
